units.statement: For every real C2 function f with compact support, the actual variance-one centered Gaussian integrates f squared, f squared times log(f squared), and the square of its real derivative. Each actual normalized Bool counting measure integrates those same functions of the signed sum divided by sqrt(N), including N=0. Their positive-index (N+1) count integrals converge respectively to the Gaussian integrals. The corresponding homogeneous entropy, including zero mass, converges to the Gaussian homogeneous entropy. All domains and limits are produced internally.

steps.title: Use the actual weak probability laws
steps.text: Invoke the verified actual count-law CLT. Its internally constructed law lambda_N equals the pushforward of the literal count law under the literal sum for everyN. The successor family converges weakly to the exact Gaussian; no caller law or limit certificate enters this theorem.

steps.title: Build the three bounded compact observers
steps.text: C2 gives continuous f and fprime. Their squares are continuous and compactly supported, since zero is preserved. The map t->t log t is continuous also at0 and takes0 to0, so f²logf² has the same compact-support property. The derivative support is contained in the support of f.
steps.formula: A=f^2,\quad B=A\log A,\quad C=(f\prime)^2,\qquad A,B,C\in C_c(\mathbb R).

steps.title: Produce genuine integrability and count-map transport
steps.text: Each continuous compact observer is genuinely Bochner integrable for every probability law lambda_N and for gamma. The finite sum map is measurable by its finite domain; Integrable.comp_measurable transfers the actual L1 property to the literal count law. The strongly measurable integral-map identity transports the same integrals. L1 is established separately, so totalized integral equalities do not replace domains.
steps.formula: \int g\,d\lambda_N=\int g(S_N)\,d\mu_N,\qquad g\in L^1(\gamma)\cap L^1(\lambda_N),\quad g\circ S_N\in L^1(\mu_N).

steps.title: Convert weak convergence to the three real integral limits
steps.text: Root ofCompactSupport packages each actual observer as a bounded continuous function without changing its values. The pinned weak-probability integral characterization gives its Gaussian integral limit. The proven map equality returns the literal successor count integrals.

steps.title: Combine the homogeneous entropy, including zero mass
steps.text: Let m_N be the actual f² count integral. The mass limit and continuous tlogt give m_N log m_N -> m log m even when m=0. Subtract this limit from the log-observer limit. The separate derivative-observer limit is not the full coordinate-flip-energy limit.
